scope: Miao Chapter 6: the motivating example, the measurability problem, the principle of optimality (Lemma 6.3.1, Theorems 6.3.1-6.3.3), optimal control (Lemma 6.4.1, Theorems 6.4.1-6.4.4, Euler equations) and its link to Theorem 6.3.2, the maximum principle (Theorem 6.5.1), the secretary problem, the consumption-saving problem, and Exercises 1-10.
source: Jianjun Miao, Economic Dynamics in Discrete Time, MIT Press 2014 (draft of 21 April 2013), Chapter 6
